articles.title: Sokin and Adyen Partner to Give US Businesses a Single Solution for Ecommerce Payments and Treasury Operations
articles.mainIdea: Sokin and Adyen Partner to Give US Businesses a Single Solution for Ecommerce Payments and Treasury Operations
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Sokin and Adyen Partner to Give US Businesses a Single Solution for Ecommerce Payments and Treasury Operations. Sokin, the cross-border business payments and financial platform, today announced a strategic global partnership with Adyen, the global financial technology platform of choice for leading businesses. The partnership adds global payment acceptance to Sokin's existing multi-currency accounts, FX, and treasury infrastructure, giving businesses a single platform to manage their entire cross-border financial stack. Related tickers mentioned: ADYEN.AS.
